content: Healthy Aging (HA) : The Healthy Aging dataset consists of speech samples of cognitively healthy participants ( INLINEFORM0 ) older than 50 years. Each participant performs three structured tasks – picture description (HAPD), verbal fluency test, and a paragraph reading task. Fluency and paragraph tasks are jointly referred to as HAFP. The average number of samples per participant is 14.46. The dataset constitutes 8.5 hours of total audio.
